**Component Area:**
- [ ] Browser / Extension (`apps/extension`, `packages/browser-utils`)
- [ ] Vision / Privacy Engine (`packages/vision-engine`, `packages/privacy-engine`, `models`)
- [ ] Agent Server / Evaluation (`services/agent-server`, `evaluation`)
- [ ] Shared Contracts (`packages/shared-types`, `packages/action-schema`, `docs`)

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is.

**Describe the Solution You'd Like:**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Alternatives You've Considered:**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional Context:**
Add any other context or references to research documents in `docs/research/`.
